title: Velocity Controller
text: 离散时间速度控制器，输入 4 路、输出 1 路；按 {Control type} 指定控制模型 PI；{Controller proportional gain} 指定比例增益、{Controller integral gain} 指定积分增益、{P controller proportional gain} 指定 P 比例增益、{Integral anti-windup gain} 指定 PI 抗积分饱和增益、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Discretization sample time} 指定离散化采样时间、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零点对消，按实例取值。

params.name: Control type
params.values: 控制模型 PI control (default) | P control | P-PI control

params.name: P controller proportional gain
params.values: P 比例增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral anti-windup gain
params.values: PI 抗积分饱和增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: 离散化采样时间 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Enable zero cancellation
params.values: 前馈零点对消 off (default) | on
